exposure: types and sizes of spinal needles
outcome: factors associated with early PDPH onset
cohort: 77 patients who received spinal anesthesia for cesarean section and developed PDPH requiring treatment with epidural blood patch
finding: Out of 35,290 parturients who underwent spinal anesthesia for cesarean section, 0.2% developed PDPH requiring treatment with epidural blood patch, and no investigated factors were found to be significantly associated with PDPH onset or peak PDPH.
